cases.oracle: FADD D0, D1, D2 reads binary64 D1/D2, writes binary64 D0 with FPCR rounding and FPSR status; width/format identity is binary64

FCMP D0, D1 produces NZCV (and FPSR) from binary64 operands as the canonical nzcv PSTATE state; B.EQ reads the NZCV.Z generic flag. The generic flag model cannot bind the FP owner's nzcv state to the integer flag cell, so the branch condition stays an explicit undefined (fail-closed) and no flag dependency is fabricated
ADD V0.4S, V1.4S, V2.4S is a 128-bit vector add of four 32-bit lanes; lane shape 4S and source/destination V-register identity are exact
LDAR X0, [X1] performs an acquire-ordered 64-bit memory read into X0 with address provenance from X1
STLR X0, [X1] performs a release-ordered 64-bit memory write of X0 with address provenance from X1

LDXR X0, [X1] sets the exclusive monitor and reads memory; STXR W2, X0, [X1] conditionally stores X0 and writes W2 status (0 success / 1 failure); the reservation monitor and conditional store-success are explicit intrinsic state, and the conditional write stays a conservative may-write, never an ordinary load/store pair

claim: Test-owned AArch64 source and linked ELF. Oracle is an independent architecture contract (A64 register/width/ordering/status roles), not product pseudocode, CodeFuse, IDA, or reference-renderer text.
